description.en: Source-backed research raster and county summaries. Map colours represent land-cover classes; dates represent classification year.
description.zh: 研究來源柵格與縣市摘要；地圖顏色呈現土地覆蓋類別，日期指分類年度。

limitation.en: 2023 research classification, not a legal forest inventory. Statistics use original pixels; the overview is generalized. Class 5 is unresolved. Offshore coverage is incomplete. A vegetation-class change alone does not prove deforestation.
limitation.zh: 2023 年研究分類，並非法定森林清查。統計採原始像元，概覽圖已概化；類別 5 尚未區分，離島涵蓋不完整。植被分類改變不等於已證實砍伐。

description.en: Source-backed research raster and county summaries. Map colours represent land-cover classes; dates represent classification year.
description.zh: 研究來源柵格與縣市摘要；地圖顏色呈現土地覆蓋類別，日期指分類年度。

limitation.en: 2023 research classification, not a legal forest inventory. Statistics use original pixels; the overview is generalized. Class 5 is unresolved. Offshore coverage is incomplete. A vegetation-class change alone does not prove deforestation.
limitation.zh: 2023 年研究分類，並非法定森林清查。統計採原始像元，概覽圖已概化；類別 5 尚未區分，離島涵蓋不完整。植被分類改變不等於已證實砍伐。

description.en: The requested 2013 raster was not present in the verified public archive.
description.zh: 經確認的公開壓縮檔未含所需的 2013 柵格。

limitation.en: The description mentions 2013/2023, but the archive contains 2015- and 2023-labelled TIFFs. We do not rename 2015 as 2013 or invent a change statistic. The linked paper says its 2013–2022 classifications are available by author request.
limitation.zh: 描述提及 2013／2023，但壓縮檔只有標示 2015、2023 的 TIFF；本平臺不將 2015 改稱 2013，也不虛構變遷統計。相關論文指出 2013–2022 分類需向作者申請。

description.en: Chen et al., Taiwan land cover data, v3. Archive checksum verified; CC BY 4.0.
description.zh: Chen 等人，Taiwan land cover data v3；已驗證壓縮檔校驗碼，CC BY 4.0。

title.zh: 方法與 2013 資料取得說明

description.en: The authors distinguish forest, built-up, water, agriculture and grassland/shrub classes; classification changes are not proof of a particular land-use cause.
description.zh: 作者區分森林、建成地、水域、農地及草地／灌叢；分類變化無法單獨證明特定土地利用原因。

title.zh: 於 Copernicus Browser 探索 Sentinel-2

description.en: Official interactive scene browser. Acquisition date, cloud coverage and processing level must be checked; imagery is distinct from this research classification. Some imagery services require a Copernicus account.
description.zh: 官方互動影像瀏覽器；請確認拍攝時間、雲量與處理等級。影像與本研究分類不同；部分影像服務需 Copernicus 帳戶。
